_comment: One is drawn at the start of every week (by weight). resources: to every player; growthPercent: this week's dwelling growth; unitGrowth: extra units per dwelling of that unit.

events.name: Good harvest
events.description: Fields are full: every player gets 1000 gold.

events.name: Week of the woodcutter
events.description: Every player gets 10 wood and 5 stone.

events.name: Plague
events.description: Sickness spreads: dwellings grow half as much this week.

events.name: Week of the skeleton
events.description: The dead stir: every skeleton dwelling gets 10 more.

events.name: Week of the militia
events.description: Volunteers come: every militia dwelling gets 10 more.

events.name: The tax collector
events.description: The crown takes 500 gold from every player.
